summary: Today, 2026-09-25, is his rest day after six sessions in a row from 2026-09-19 to 2026-09-24. I read every note in that week by hand. There are three: 'Too early in morning' on the deadlift (2026-09-20), 'Last set reverse db curl' (2026-09-20), and 'Your weight suggestions make zero sense' on the calf raise (2026-09-21). None of them mentions pain, a tweak, soreness or illness. Nothing in his whole log does. The automatic pain search flags one line from 2026-08-23, and that line is a question about how many sets to do, not a pain report. The four deload sessions were short and even: 27, 28 and 31 minutes, with most sets about 1.5 to 2.5 minutes apart. Last night's Legs B shows 69 minutes, but that number is the time from his first set (2026-09-24T15:00:46Z) to his last (2026-09-24T16:09:49Z). Everything up to the first cable crunch set, at 2026-09-24T15:21:16Z, took about 20 minutes. The second cable crunch set was logged at 2026-09-24T16:09:49Z, 48 minutes 33 seconds after the first. The rest timer for that set had ended at 2026-09-24T15:22:16Z. The log does not say why, and I am not guessing. There are two other gaps like it. On 2026-09-20 the second face-pull set is stamped 2026-09-21T15:14:32Z, about 27.5 hours after the first, so it was typed in the next day. On 2026-09-20 and 2026-09-21 the hip abductor and adductor sets are stamped 2 and 7 seconds apart. His last bodyweight is 207 lb on 2026-08-23. That is 33 days old, and none of the six sessions this week has one. No cardio or conditioning work is logged this month, so I cannot judge his conditioning. Push muscles were last trained on 2026-09-22 (Push B, deload, two sets each, 28 minutes). By tomorrow they will have had four days off. I see no grounds for a veto.
